story: AgentMessy — DIVD owned by autonomous AI agent via Zammad 0-days
hook: The vuln-hunters got hunted. An AI agent owned them.
lesson: Post-exploit at machine speed beats human IR tempo; segmentation + kill-switch still matter.

slides.body: CVE-2026-102489: session hijack to RCE. CVE-2026-102490: priv-esc to root. Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD) breached Sep 21.

title: Then they
dropped an
AI agent for
post-exploit.
slides.body: Not a human clicking. An automated agent decided next steps itself "at the speed of light." Password-sprayed into its own AiTM. Over-documented every choice.

Very, very
messy.

them.
slides.body: DIVD's words. Merlon Security co-found. NCSC alert. Even a sloppy agent that over-explains itself still outruns human IR tempo.

slides.body: Segmentation + kill-switch still matter when the attacker is an agent. Post-exploit at machine speed beats your SOC's coffee break.
